question.:question/problem: Which of the following diagrams gives the slope field at the points indicated for the differential equation $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=2-(-1)xy?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
We have to sketch the slope field at the points $(2,0)$,$(-3,3)$,$(-2,-3)$.

To sketch the slope field at the given points, we substitute their coordinates into the right-hand side of the differential equation.

$$
\begin{aligned} & {\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}|}_{(2,0)}=2-(-1)(2)(0)=2, \\  & {\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}|}_{(-3,3)}=2-(-1)(-3)(3)=-7, \\  & {\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}|}_{(-2,-3)}=2-(-1)(-2)(-3)=8.\end{aligned}
$$

Setting up our points and drawing our line segments, we get the following diagram.
